body:
## What

- `RunControls` (`src/widgets/run-inspector/ui/RunControls.tsx`): on an active run with `cancelRequested: true` the cancel button turns into an inactive «Отмена запрошена». It stays the same element: no `danger`, `aria-disabled="true"` and Ant Design's own disabled class (`${getPrefixCls('btn')}-disabled`) instead of native `disabled`, no click handler. A live active run and terminal runs are unchanged.
- `RunControls.test.tsx`:
  - the requested state on `running` and `publishing`: `aria-disabled`, not natively disabled, antd colour and disabled classes, no mutation, no «Отменить»;
  - the focus stays on the same DOM node when the button switches;
  - the live «Отменить» stays enabled, with `danger` and without the disabled class;
  - a terminal run with the flag shows no cancel-side button.
- `docs/FRONTEND_ARCHITECTURE.md`, run statuses section (`:1062`): the paragraph that said cancel/retry had no UI now describes `RunControls`, the «Попытка» field in `RunHeader` and the requested-cancel state.
- No new dependencies.

## Why

- The acceptance of #111 ([comment](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-ui-t6/issues/111#issuecomment-6238528150)) flagged `FRONTEND_ARCHITECTURE.md:1062` («UI для них — вне спринта») as stale. A re-check showed that was only half right: the buttons exist, but `cancelRequested` was read nowhere outside the Zod schema. After a cancel on a `running`/`publishing` run the API keeps the status and sets `cancelRequested: true` until the worker stops (`cancelRun` in the api OpenAPI). So the live «Отменить» stayed, and nothing showed that the request was taken. The tech lead ruled to fix it in a small PR under #111; the issue stays closed.
- Why `aria-disabled` and not `disabled`: the first version used a natively disabled button on a new element. The browser check found the focus falling to `BODY` after Enter on «Отменить», which breaks `.agents/rules/frontend.md` §3b item 3, and a natively disabled button cannot hold focus.
- In antd 6.6.5:
  - the disabled look is `&:disabled, &.ant-btn-disabled` (`button/style/variant.js:244`);
  - hover and press apply only under `:not(:disabled):not(.ant-btn-disabled)` (`variant.js:47`);
  - the focus ring applies under `&:not(:disabled)` (`button/style/index.js:62`);
  - antd itself pairs the same class with `aria-disabled` on its disabled link button (`Button.js:275-283`).

  So the look is antd's disabled look in our tokens, with no CSS of ours (frontend.md §3a rule 5).
- No `danger` on the requested state: DESIGN_SYSTEM §8 keeps `danger` for actions.

## How to verify

- Gates, all six in a clean work tree on 085a4b3: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm check-types`, `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm test` (105 files, 1271 tests), `pnpm build`, `pnpm verify:prod-bundle` (22 files clean).
- `pnpm exec vitest run src/widgets/run-inspector/ui/RunControls.test.tsx` runs 11 tests. Each new assertion was proven by breaking the code on purpose, and each break turned its test red:
  - native `disabled` on the requested state;
  - `danger` on the requested state;
  - two separate buttons instead of one (the focus test);
  - the disabled class on the live button;
  - no `danger` on the live button.
- Browser check (`.agents/rules/frontend.md` §3b). Setup: Chrome via Playwright, mock mode (`VITE_USE_MOCKS=true`), `/runs/11111111-1111-4111-8111-000000000002` (running) and `…0003` (publishing), dark and light, 1440px and 390px. Results:
  - Tab reaches «Отменить», which shows the 2px `--rv-link` ring.
  - One Enter sends exactly one cancel.
  - The focus stays on «Отмена запрошена» with the ring visible.
  - Enter, Space and a click on it send nothing more and show no toast.
  - Its colours equal those of a plain disabled button and do not change on hover.
  - Height 32px, no console errors, no horizontal scroll.
  - Jsdom keeps the focus on a natively disabled button, so the focus drop can only be seen in the browser.
- Not covered: the real API, other browsers, a screen reader.

### Known, not changed here

- Pre-existing on `main`: cancelling a `queued` run turns it `cancelled` at once, so «Отменить» unmounts and the focus falls to `BODY` (one more Tab reaches «Перезапустить»). The same is expected, but not measured, when a requested cancel completes and the run turns terminal.
- The widget relies on antd's internal class `ant-btn-disabled`, and no upgrade check (DESIGN_SYSTEM §11, `antd.button.test.tsx`) covers it. A guard belongs in `src/shared/ui`, outside this PR.

## Refs

Refs #111

Overlap: open #106, #109 and #122 also edit `docs/FRONTEND_ARCHITECTURE.md`, in other sections. For that file `git merge-tree` with each head is clean. #109 does show conflicts in the mocks, but they are with `main` since #110, not with this branch. A heads-up is left in each PR.

Squash merge recommended: the first two commits carry a native `disabled` that later commits replace.
